sourceBaseline.note: The retained source inventory records the suite bytes and runner membership but not an execution result; the read-only reference was not executed from its cwd.

cases.title: refuses a stale fence without changing the record
obligations: renewing with a stale fence rejects with agent_session_checkpoint_stale
the rejected renewal does not change lastRenewedAt

cases.title: leaves every session durable when a later renewal was superseded
obligations: a later stale renewal rejects the whole batch with agent_session_checkpoint_stale
the earlier in-memory record is rolled back exactly
the durable store bytes remain unchanged
reopening retains a non-empty provider handle chain for every record
